title: Temporal Behavioral Genome V5 — Design Artifact

feature_families.name: Call N-grams
feature_families.description: Extends V3 bigrams to trigrams. Captures 3-call sequential patterns and Shannon diversity of transition sequences.

feature_families.name: Exception Transitions
feature_families.description: Records (pre_call_idx, exception_type, post_call_idx) triples at each exception. Recovery rate = fraction of exceptions followed by a normal call.
feature_families.invariance_mechanism: Function indices for pre/post; exception type strings are class names (intrinsically invariant)

feature_families.name: Causal Chains
feature_families.description: For every function-index pair (i,j): if i precedes j in >50% of co-occurrences, record (i,j) as causal. Causal entropy = mean binary entropy of ordering probabilities.
feature_families.invariance_mechanism: Integer indices; ordering probabilities derived from call sequence positions

feature_families.name: Phase Diversity
feature_families.description: Split call sequence into setup/main/teardown phases (equal thirds). Compute normalized Shannon entropy per phase. Vector = [setup_div, main_div, teardown_div].
feature_families.invariance_mechanism: Integer indices in frequency count; phase boundaries by position ratio

feature_families.name: Loop Profiles
feature_families.description: Contiguous run length per function index in call sequence. Mean run length captures loop depth. CV of all run lengths = early_exit_score (high = irregular loops).
feature_families.invariance_mechanism: Dict keyed by str(anon_idx); values are run-length statistics

components.name: d_exc_transitions
components.formula: Jaccard distance on exception triple sets

extraction_api.signature: extract(events: List[dict], name_to_idx: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None, program_id: str = 'unknown') -> TemporalGenomeV5
notes: If name_to_idx is None, built from first-call order in the event list.
Providing a pre-built map enables cross-program comparison with shared index space.

steps: Round all float values to 6 decimal places
Clamp floats to [0,1] where semantically appropriate

tests.name: test_rename_invariance
tests.property: Same call structure under different names → same trigrams

tests.name: test_swapped_causal
tests.property: Swapped call order → different causal_precedence_set (shared index map)

tests.name: test_trigram_extraction_5call
tests.property: 5-call sequence → 3 trigrams with correct keys and equal frequencies

relationship_to_prior_versions.v5_temporal: Adds trigrams, exception transitions, causal chains, phase diversity, loop profiles. Standalone extractor — no dependency on V2/V3 normalizer.
